title: Two incidents at an office network
body: The network administrator of a small office investigates two security incidents reported in the same week. Incident 1: An attacker secretly tapped a channel of the office network and picked up all the traffic passing through it. The captured packets were analysed later, and the attacker's software reproduced the exact packets and placed them back in the channel, so the communication appeared normal to the staff. Because the data was not encrypted, some customer details leaked. Incident 2: During a live video conference between two managers, an outsider listened to the conversation as it happened. A rootkit malware on one manager's laptop had given the outsider control of the built-in microphone and camera, so the private conversation was monitored in real time without either manager knowing.
